thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Multi-GPU inference cluster reporting repeated NCCL rendezvous timeouts and CUDA driver resets on pool-gpu-prod-7. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
sarah (oncall): I'm on it. Observed spike in job failures around 12:07 UTC, errors show up as NCCL_TIMEOUT and 'cudaLaunchKernel' failures. Rolling through logs now.
raj (eng-runtime): Copying relevant logs here. We see communicator creation stalling, then repeated retries, then containers OOM while waiting for rendezvous.
emily (dl-infra): Two nodes reported 'GPU driver lost' followed by container crashloop. Looks like NVLink flaps on those hosts. Hostnames: node-14, node-15.
mike (sre): Network level didn't show infra-wide packet loss. No recent fabric upgrade. Could be hardware NIC/GPU link.
kevin (support): Customer-impact report — several customers running large TP models saw increased 5xxs starting ~12:10 UTC; we have a handful of high-throughput jobs failing.
sarah (oncall): Initial mitigation plan: 1) Quarantine affected nodes (cordon + drain). 2) Route new TP workloads away from Dedicated pool. 3) Trigger fallback to single-GPU model variants for latency-sensitive tenants. Anyone object?
raj (eng-runtime): Agree. Add automatic communicator teardown on long rendezvous. We can push a hotfix to reduce rendezvous timeout from 120s -> 20s and fast-fail to fallback path.
emily (dl-infra): Draining nodes now: `kubectl cordon node-14 && kubectl drain node-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (same for node-15). Starting live drain 12:18 UTC.
ops-bot: node-14 drained successfully at 1767123505. node-15 drain failed on Pod sandbox delete — retrying.
mike (sre): While drains happen, shifting routing: Updating routing rule for pool-gpu-prod to exclude node-14/15. Rolling traffic to pool-gpu-aux. ETA ~2m.
raj (eng-runtime): Hotfix pushed to runtime: changed rendezvous timeout to 20s and enabled immediate communicator fallback. Patch id: rwd-runtime-2026-03-15-ht1. Deploying to canary (10% traffic) now.
incident-bot: Deploy rwd-runtime-2026-03-15-ht1 started. Canary route applied to service: inference-runtime-canary.
sarah (oncall): Customer update draft: "We are investigating an infrastructure issue causing GPU worker flaps and multi-GPU job failures. We have isolated the affected hosts and are routing traffic to healthy capacity. Expected mitigation in progress." Any additions?
kevin (support): Add note: "Temporary fallbacks to single-GPU model variants may cause increased latency for some requests." Also collecting list of impacted tenants — I'll post once available.
emily (dl-infra): Node-15 drain succeeded at 1767123620. Both nodes out of rotation. Hardware team looped in to inspect NVLink cabling and GPU health logs.
raj (eng-runtime): Canary metrics look promising: rendezvous failures dropped from 18/min -> 0/min on canary. Memory pressure on canary pods also stable. Promoting hotfix to 50%.
mike (sre): Promoting hotfix to 100% now. Observability hooks: watch NCCL errors, cudaReset counters, and container restart rate. Alert thresholds adjusted for the incident.
incident-bot: Deploy rwd-runtime-2026-03-15-ht1 promoted to prod at 1767123890.
sarah (oncall): After hotfix, failures reduced dramatically. Remaining errors look like residual retry storms hitting scheduler. We'll keep automatic scaling suppressed for next 30m to avoid thrash.
raj (eng-runtime): Added a short-term patch: when communicator creation fails X times, runtime falls back to model-serial execution (no TP) instead of retrying on same PG. Patch id rwd-runtime-2026-03-15-ht2.
emily (dl-infra): Hardware team reports early signs of degraded NVLink on node-14 (one link reporting CRC errors). They're scheduling OOB maintenance; nodes will stay cordoned until hardware replace.
kevin (support): Impact summary so far: ~12 tenants experienced increased error rates, most traffic auto-fell back to single-GPU versions, a subset had elevated latency for 10-30 minutes. No data loss reported.
mike (sre): Post-incident actions: add runbook step to detect NVLink CRC via `nvidia-smi nvlink --status`, surface earlier in alerts; add automated route to fallback variants when NCCL_TIMEOUT exceeds threshold; notify capacity team to pre-warm aux pool.
sarah (oncall): Filing incident ticket with timeline and action items. Thanks team. I'll mark this as handed off to oncall-ops for hardware replacement and runtime follow-up. Leaving notes in incident tracker.
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated at 1767124200. Follow-up: create postmortem and track hardware replacement and runtime persistent fix.
raj (eng-runtime): I'll take the runtime follow-up: durable fix to communicator timeouts and smarter fallback routing.
emily (dl-infra): I'll own the hardware replace + validation of NVLink links on node-14/15.
kevin (support): I'll draft the customer postmortem and send to affected tenant contacts. Working on communication now.
sarah (oncall): Closing handoff. If anything regresses, re-open the thread. :thumbsup:
